reports.title: Designing Toward a Theory: An AI-Assisted Writing System as Design Experiment
reports.subtitle: A thirteen-month design experiment in applied systems science
reports.description: A case study of a thirteen-month design experiment in applied systems science: modeling the cognitive structure of expert long-form writing and building an AI-assisted environment — Systemic Writer — scaffolded around that structure rather than around text generation.
reports.author: Kurt Rowley

reports.title: Energy Envelopes and Feedback Loops
reports.subtitle: Why pacing works when rest doesn't
reports.description: A systems-level explanation of why rest alone fails ME/CFS patients, and what the feedback dynamics of post-exertional malaise actually suggest about pacing as intervention.
reports.author: Kurt Rowley

reports.title: Evolutionary Futurism
reports.subtitle: Attractor mapping for long-range civilizational trajectories
reports.description: Applies evolutionary and complex systems science to long-range civilizational questions — not prediction, but attractor mapping of where the trajectory is heading and where the leverage points lie.
reports.author: Kurt Rowley

reports.title: Human Spiritual Systems
reports.subtitle: Spiritual practice as a persistent complex-systems attractor
reports.description: Applies attractor analysis, feedback modeling, and network dynamics to why spiritual systems form, sustain themselves, and interact with health, governance, and knowledge systems — as structure, not theology.
reports.author: Kurt Rowley

reports.title: The Attractor Engineering Framework
reports.subtitle: Applied complexity science organized for practice
reports.description: Synthesizes five interdisciplinary traditions — General Systems Theory, Cybernetics, Complexity Science, Systems Dynamics, and Information Systems Theory — into nine core concepts across three tiers, from the ontology of complex systems to the operators of effective intervention.
reports.author: Kurt Rowley

reports.title: ISRD Research Foundations
reports.subtitle: The theoretical lineages and prior work underlying ISRD
reports.description: Describes the research context underlying all ISRD work — five theoretical traditions in systems science, three domain research programs, and Kurt Rowley's two decades of prior published work in instructional design and educational technology.
reports.author: Kurt Rowley

reports.title: Science & Religion: The Philosophical Divide
reports.subtitle: A systems-theoretic examination of two epistemic systems
reports.description: A systems-theoretic examination of the structural conflict between scientific and religious epistemologies — identifying where the divide is genuine, where it is constructed, and where synthesis is possible.
reports.author: Kurt Rowley

reports.title: Are We Alone? Systemic Evidence Synthesis
reports.subtitle: A cross-domain synthesis of evidence bearing on extraterrestrial life and intelligence
reports.description: Applies systems science methodology to evaluate empirical, theoretical, and anomalous evidence streams bearing on extraterrestrial life and intelligence with epistemic discipline, holding each stream to its own appropriate standard.
reports.author: Kurt Rowley
